name: @explorable-models/study-harness-tauri-reference
description: Packaged Tauri 2 reference host for the Study Harness visualizer: a conformance fixture built from the packed library tarballs. Not a root workspace and not a Study Harness application.

scripts.build:web: npm run policy && npm run typecheck && vite build --config vite.config.mjs --mode production
scripts.build:web:conformance: npm run policy && npm run typecheck && vite build --config vite.config.mjs --mode conformance
scripts.test:rust: cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --locked && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --locked --features conformance
scripts.lint:rust: cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --locked --all-targets --features conformance -- -D warnings
